description: This file contains configuration interfaces, extension methods, and a concrete class for setting up and configuring persistent streaming providers within an Orleans cluster client environment. It primarily defines how to configure stream pub/sub types, lifecycle options, and integrates with Orleans' dependency injection system to set up persistent stream providers.

classes.name: ClusterClientPersistentStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Concrete implementation of a client-side persistent stream configurator, responsible for setting up the stream provider with dependency injection and configuration delegates.

methods.name: ConfigureStreamPubSub
methods.description: Configures the stream pub/sub type for the persistent stream provider.

methods.name: ConfigureLifecycle
methods.description: Configures lifecycle options for the stream, specifically for client-side persistent streams.

methods.name: ClusterClientPersistentStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stream configurator with the specified provider name, client builder, and adapter factory.
